notes.title: Demonheart: The Cursed Trial Launched!
notes.content:
After more than two years of development and polish, Demonheart: The Cursed Trial is now fully released!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27939525/31bc05a8c948a911314958b915c492390642fce3.png

Out of Early Access.
The visual novel is complete with all its planned features and fully playable from the start to the bitter end! ːedgardoː With multiple endings.

Partial voice acting added
All seven chapters now include some voice lines to better establish the characters.

Mac version now available
The game now supports both Windows and macOS.

Artbook DLC released
Take a behind-the-scenes look at sketches, concepts and early drafts in a beautifully compiled PDF! Grab the artbook and support future creative projects.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27939525/abb2b1e1af95620866f824f4813859f17f9f3fb5.jpg

I've poured a lot into this visual novel over the past years - writing, editing, coordinating, testing... It was the story I really wanted to tell, and I hope you'll enjoy the finished version.

Now is the perfect time to jump in - or back in!

If you've enjoyed it, a short review or share on social media really helps spread the word!

Thank you for supporting indie games and making releases like this possible!💜

- Lamb

notes.title: Demonheart: The Cursed Trial - Just got its final chapter!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I've got exciting news - The Cursed Trial has just been finished with its final chapter now live!

What is it about?
A demonspawn has participated in capturing some humans and keeps them trapped. He urges them to fight among themselves. Your character (with a customizable name) can start a romance with one of two male captives who may or may not be bad guys... And more.

Why check it out now?
The full story is complete! No more waiting for updates!
*The game will still be in early access until we get some voice acting and fix any potential issues.

Thank you for your support, and I hope you enjoy it!
- Lamb ːhappy_yetiː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620701/b82a4d08b0d6d6e6ccf5e4492186d3357d5aed03.jpg

notes.title: Demonheart: The Cursed Trial - Chapter 7 Progress
notes.content:
Hello, demonhearts and visual novel enjoyers!

I'm glad to say that we've been making good progress on the last chapter of Demonheart: The Cursed Trial.

A certain player choice will branch the story, the characters will say some different things as a consequence of previous choices, and there will be multiple endings. Because of this, the last chapter has a much higher word count, so there is more content to polish than in the previous chapters. We have yet to see how it will affect the actual play time.

I am currently editing the script, adding smaller player choices. The major ones are already implemented. While I shared some early screenshots before, my priority right now is to polish up the script before setting up all the visuals.

The aim is to add Chapter 7 to the game in the second half of March. It will remain in early access for a little while after that, to make sure there aren't any oversights. Also, after the last chapter is published, I will start looking for voice actors and directing them to implement partial voice acting.

I hope to be back soon with the last chapter! Thank you for your interest!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33404344/55c887000bd695a76290a52aee1670249aca7f45.png

notes.title: Demonheart: The Cursed Trial - Chapter 6 Released!
notes.content:
My latest project in the Demonheart world just got a major update!

Demonheart: The Cursed Trial Chapter 6 is out!

With around 21.900 words of new content, this takes the game over 133.000 words - my longest game so far. 

The story continues, with only one more chapter left to go (which will have multiple endings.)

I hope you'll enjoy the new addition! 

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33404344/9839c1bd8183b6c3b1bd295c68fb720df5b72fe6.jpg

The Cursed Trial is a murder mystery / romance in which Raze ("The Seer") has captured a group of humans for the entertainment of his demonic master. (Raze doesn't really have a master, he just made a deal with someone and is playing along.)

The main character, whose name you can change, can fall in love with two of her fellow captives.

If you haven't joined in on the adventure yet, consider doing so now by wishlisting or purchasing The Cursed Trial - your interest and support help me develop these niche games!

notes.title: Progress Update - End of November 2023
notes.content:
Hello! I'm here with a progress update on Demonheart: The Cursed Trial, which came out in early access.

I'm happy with the reactions the game has received so far, as well as the love certain characters are getting. ːhappy_yetiː

There is now fanart of the Cursed Trial characters.  ːsurprised_yetiː Some of it is in the Artwork section in the Steam community, and more art has been posted on the Rolling Crown Discord or Tumblr, Twitter etc, if you search for it.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33404344/f1cd77c8c327470d262484aa7a923ef4ce2cdd87.png

I have been working on the script for the next chapter. As of today, around 12.400 words are in-game for Chapter 4, with more in text documents, waiting to be edited and used. After I am done with the first version of the text, the game will still need testing, scene edits for the scenes that turn out to need it, and polish such as adding sound effects. There will be two new CGs, which are already finished. The estimate for the chapter's release is early February.

I have posted the planned timeline for releasing all the chapters on the store page and in the Steam discussions here - it could change over time, but that is the general plan. With the holiday season ahead, I expected late December and early January to be a slower time for work, so that's why Chapter 4 is planned to come out in February, even though it feels like it could be finished sooner. ːdazed_yetiː

notes.title: We have a Launch Date! - Demonheart: The Cursed Trial
notes.content:
After a lengthy consideration, we've decided to launch in Steam Early Access sooner rather than later.

So far, we've had some amazing feedback and player theories. Also, it feels really great to discuss the VN with players while I'm still writing it as opposed to working on the story alone in the dark for two years. ːedgardoː

The game currently contains three polished chapters out of the seven planned chapters. Voice acting is planned for the future, when all the text is finished. The word counts are 19.000 to 26.000 words per chapter - a little over 67.000 words so far. When it's fully finished, this will be Rolling Crown's longest VN yet. ːsurprised_yetiː

The launch is scheduled for November 13th!
Wishlist the game if you haven't already done so ːhappy_yetiː and thank you for following!

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33404344/151aa6ee519f0c268d56c35ad5e3982f45fbef4a.png

notes.title: Cursed Trial - Demo Update
notes.content:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33404344/b7238acd9f3138009f0174eb5580a6a91ba2728b.jpg

While working on the third out of the seven chapters of Demonheart: The Cursed Trial, I went back to the first chapter (demo) and made some edits. There are a lot of small changes which you may or may not notice if you replay.

Changes:

 Rephrased many lines of narration and dialog.
 Changed some expressions and sprite positions. Changed Ran's expression on several occasions into less childish and more manly ones. ':)
 Added a few new choices and NPC lines - nothing crucial, but these changes will mess with old saves. Old alignment and relationship points will be preserved, but you may end up on the wrong line when you reload.
 Started silently tracking Janiya's approval. Old saves didn't track this, so it will be like your relationship with her was neutral. Which is not the worst it could be. ':)
 Changed some sound effects.


The demo is available here! Don't forget to wishlist the Cursed Trial!

Meanwhile, the third chapter is nearly finished, and when it's polished, there's a possibility of Steam early access! Stay tuned for news about it, and thank you for following!

notes.title: Devlog - September 2023
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33404344/ea660e1de8a602dae290abb73a0beb44b23ec469.jpg

Hello there!

I'm thrilled to share an update on the progress of Demonheart: The Cursed Trial. It's been a journey filled with inspiration and dedication, and I want to thank you all for your patience and support.

I've finished writing and scripting the final scenes for Chapter 3. The plot twists have started, so I have to be careful about posting screenshots. ːlaughingprismː All the scenes are now fully playable, currently only available to myself for testing. ːedgardoː There's still work ahead - testing and ensuring a smooth logic flow to make sure everything feels just right before I move on to the following chapters.

✨ Early Access Plans:
I'm considering early access on Steam, so stay tuned for updates on that front. Your support during this phase will be crucial in shaping the final product. Wishlist the game here!

💌 Stay in the Loop: To ensure you don't miss any critical updates, including early access announcements, consider joining my  mailing list. It's the best way to stay connected and be among the first to know about Rolling Crown's latest projects!

Thank you for being part of this journey. I can't wait to share more of the Cursed Trial with you soon!
